task.title: P6-029: Add scroll-into-view for the highlighted row in command
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 7 — UX, a11y and visual, Accessibility). Original id: P6-029. Size: S. Specs: specs/ui-components.md, specs/app-ui.md.

**`command` has no scroll-into-view for the highlighted row.** `CommandList` caps at ~21 rem, so `↑↓` past the fold moves the highlight off-screen with no scroll — the user is navigating a row they cannot see. No `scrollIntoView` exists anywhere under `app/src`. Affects the ⌘K palette, the destination picker and quick-add equally, so it belongs in `app/src/components/ui/command.rs`, not in any one consumer (upstream's deleted vanilla-JS layer did this). The `visible_ids()` O(n²) half was split out to `P6-172`.
